activity.notes: Thomas Aquinas returned to Paris in 1252 for advanced theological study and teaching, became master of theology in 1256, and held the Dominican chair through 1259. ATLAS uses this well-attested Paris intellectual-activity interval in the Kingdom of France rather than his full lifespan or later movements among several Italian political contexts.

sources.title: Thomas Aquinas — Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
sources.citation_text: The Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy records Aquinas's return to Paris in 1252 for advanced theology, his appointment as master of theology in 1256, and his Dominican chair there until 1259.
